card.name: Words just before a body part
card.fires_on: Small words like each, the, one, both, of, and his that come right before an expected body-part noun such as ear, eye, vertebra, or ovary. The setting is anatomy or paired organs.

modes.label: Before paired organs
modes.description: A determiner or quantifier sits just before ear or eye.

modes.description: A linking word comes before a vertebra, side, or eye-area term.

card.writes: It pushes toward anatomy-type words and away from common limb and position words like thigh, shoulder, and anterior.
card.plain: It fires on small words that sit right before a body part is named, especially ears, eyes, and the spine.
